buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Board of Radiation & Isotope Technology (BRIT) is an independent unit of Department of Atomic Energy (D AE) which provides products and services based on Radiations & Isotopes for applications in Healthcare, A griculture, Research and Industry. BRIT has its Head Office located at Sector-20, Vashi, Navi Mumbai. BRIT Local Area Network (LAN) is being operated from central Server Room located at Vashi complex. Opti cal Fiber cables that connects all the buildings in the premises have been routed from this centralize room. Wall Mount Rack loaded with switches (L2) are installed in individual building and these switches are conne cted to core switch (L3) through optical Fiber cables up to central server room.

Presently around 270 nodes are connected through LAN. It is intended to maintain the network through No n-Comprehensive Computer network Maintenance Contract. BRIT, Vashi Complex, Navi Mumbai needs one qualified residential Onsite Engineer for period of two years for maintaining local area network. Network Maintenance of the following Active/Passive devices and electronic equipment: a) Layer 2 Ethernet Switches: 35 Nos. b) Layer 3 Ethernet: 02 Nos. c) Total computer network points (I/Os ): 270Nos. 1. About On Site Engineer: a) The Vendor is required to provide evidence in dealing with qualification and experience cri teria which would be checked by this Office (BRIT) during bid’s technical qualification to v erify the suitability/competency of the service engineer. b) The On Site service Engineer provided by the vendor shall not be changed frequently. Ho wever, if found incompetent by the officers of BRIT, the On-Site-Engineer shall be changed by the vendor immediately. c) If an On-Site-Engineer needs to take leave in emergency situation, a suitable replacement should be provided. 2. Onsite Engineer Qualification and experience criteria: (3yrs qualification+ 2yrs experience) a) Three-year Diploma in or Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) in Computer Science and en gineering or Information Technology, or an equivalent technical discipline from a recognized institution. b) The candidate must have a minimum of two (2) years of relevant work experience i n network installation, configuration, operation, and maintenance. c) Engineer shall be able to prove 2years of experience in Computer Networking areas by his Employers certificates. 3. The candidate should have practical knowledge and experience in: a) Installation, configuration, and maintenance of LAN, WAN, and Wi-Fi net works. b) Configuration and troubleshooting of Layer 2/Layer 3 switches, routers, and wireless access points. c) Management of network devices from OEMs such as Dlink, Cisco, HPE, J uniper, or equivalent. d) Network monitoring, fault diagnosis, preventive maintenance, and perfo rmance optimization. e) IP addressing, VLANs, routing, switching, DHCP, DNS, NAT, VPN, and bas ic network security. f) Fiber optic and structured cabling, including testing and troubleshooting . g) Firewall configuration, access control, antivirus, and endpoint security. h) Maintenance of network documentation, inventory, and service logs.

i) Coordination with Internet Service Providers (ISPs) and OEM support tea ms for fault resolution. j) Providing on-site technical support and ensuring maximum network upti me. k) Preference may be given to candidates holding industry-recognized cert ifications such as CCNA, CCNP or equivalent. l) The Network Maintenance Engineer shall be responsible for ensuring uni nterrupted operation of the organization's network infrastructure, carryi ng out preventive and corrective maintenance, resolving network faults within the prescribed timelines, and maintaining the required service lev els. 4. Responsibilities of On-Site Engineer (1 No). a) The Engineer shall be made available on-site from 09:00 to 17:30 hours from Tuesday t o Saturday on all working days and on holidays “on call” in case of emergency. b) The services of the engineer of the contractor may be required on non- working days ( Sun day, Monday and Holiday) or beyond office hours on working days on some occasions t o meet emergency/urgent situation. The vendor shall ensure that on such occasions also t he engineer should be deputed with no extra cost/payment/facility. c) The Network maintenance contract person shall take overall responsibility of all the activiti es related to the Network. d) The engineer should have knowledge and experience to work with networking devices and protocols, configuration of Switches (Layer-2 & Layer-3) and security devices such as firew all and antivirus etc. e) The on-site engineer shall take care of jobs mentioned above in the BRIT Vashi Complex. H e shall attend to any break down maintenance calls and carry out all kind of miscellaneous maintenance jobs pertaining to the network. f) He/she will act as the first respondent upon receipt of a daily complaints as well as the m aintenance work. g) Maintenance and Operations of Network Switches and racks, helping users for Network related issues, maintaining physical end-to-end connectivity of the network, providing assistance in addition / alteration of network points, co-ordination with ISP in case of any fa ilure of WAN (Internet) connectivity shall be the responsibility of network engineer. h) He shall carry out all the following network related jobs like:- i. To attend the computer network complaints on daily basis and maintaining the log b ooks. ii. Configurations and replacement of L3 & L2 switches if required. iii. He shall able to trace out the fault with respect to Cat6/Cat6A cables or I/O problems , termination of Cat6/6A cables on patch panel, crimping and punching of Cat6/Cat 6A cables etc. iv. Shifting of Network devices such as switches, PCs, Servers, Display Monitors, Rack, UPS etc. v. During preventive maintenance, cleaning of active and passive networking devices such as L3 & L2 switches at each building site and server room, Servers of BRIT, Ra cks range 9U to 42U Racks, UPS range 600VA to 1.5 KVA etc. from outside with liq uid cleaner should be done once in a quarter. vi. Preventive maintenance will be carried out on quarterly basis which involves chec king health condition of switches, UPS backup, cleaning of racks, switches, rack co oling fan, cat 6 cables inside. Also make sure cable tie, dressing, tagging in existin g racks are proper. i) All daily complaints report, Preventive Maintenance Report (quarterly) and cleaning reports of all the items installed at different locations should be submitted along with the quarterl y bill in the name of “Pay and Accounts officer, Board of Radiation & Isotope Technology, B

RIT-BARC, Vashi Complex, Sector-20, Navi Mumbai-400703. j) The quarterly payment will be made strictly on the basis of satisfactory PM report of the us ers BRIT. k) Vacuum cleaners/ air blower, crimping & punching tools, cable continuity tester (LAN), mul ti-meter etc. shall be provided by the vendor and it shall always be available with on-site e ngineer. The engineer shall use his own tools during computer Network maintenance contr act. l) There should be a gap of minimum 2 months between the two consecutive Preventive Maintenances of any equipment. m) Engineer shall carry out troubleshooting and break down maintenance of network at BRIT V ashi Complex with BRIT. n) Any other task that is not included above but is essential for the smooth functioning of the I T department will be performed by the service engineer. o) No TA/DA shall be paid during whole computer Network maintenance contract. period for t he visit outside BRIT, Vashi to other units of BRIT. p) All complaints logged by 11 am must be attended same day and it shall be rectified within 2 working days. If not done, please report the issue to the Senior Manager, CNM and resolv e it as early as possible. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
